title: Solve an equation reducible to quadratic (u = x^2)

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Quadratic Equations, Functions, Zeros, and Models

process_card: Solving an equation reducible to quadratic

steps.name: choose u so the equation becomes quadratic in u
replace u and solve for the original variable

mistakes.name: stopped at u
mistakes.message: u is not the answer: put x^2 back and solve for x.

mistakes.name: forgot ±
mistakes.message: x^2 = 4 gives x = ±2: two solutions for each u.

hints.step: choose u so the equation becomes quadratic in u
hints.why: With u = x^2 the equation is an ordinary quadratic in u.
It's a quadratic you already know how to solve.

hints.step: replace u and solve for the original variable
hints.hint: Write x^2 = each u value and use the principle of square roots.
hints.why: The question asks for x, not u.

hints.hint: Substitute each x into the original equation.
